scope_note: The joint book is a predecessor source. Calling its technique cathartic prevents the 1895 work from being silently relabelled as the fully developed later psychoanalytic method.
statement: Breuer and Freud's jointly signed 1895 preface presented their therapeutic technique as the cathartic method.
statement_zh: Breuer 與 Freud 在 1895 年共同署名的序言中，把書內的治療技術稱為「宣洩法」。
